label: Deep refresh across all criteria (17 Nov 2026), including AI-generated works
description: Multi-language sweep across every catalog topic, 17 Nov 2026, plus a dedicated search for AI-generated films, shorts, vertical/micro dramas, YouTube/TikTok/Bilibili/Douyin series, AI anime, and AI comics/webtoons. Focus on titles new since the 16 Nov 2026 deep refresh, plus deeper and older titles not yet found, vertical dramas, and non-English works. Adults only; non-explicit notes; every entry sourced with a confidence label. AI-generated works are marked in format/meta and tagged AI-generated. This file was created at the start of the run and appended at the true end of SOURCES so existing IDs do not shift.

records.title: 巨乳人妻寝取られ催眠 ～シェアハウスで管理人と妻が…… ～
records.meta: ADV · Japan · Japanese · Studio 偽恋 (Giren) / Lune Soft · released 28 Feb 2020 · 18+ age-gated official product page · keywords include 人妻 and 催眠
records.character: 高垣 織奈 (Takagaki Orina, a newlywed housewife); also 四分儀 紗璃 (Shikakui Sari, another married resident)
records.summary: Newlyweds Keiichi and Orina move into a share house rumored to help couples conceive, living alongside another married couple and the young owner, who researches hypnosis. Official copy indicates the wives’ behavior toward the owner is altered so that, from the husband’s point of view, nothing seems out of the ordinary.
records.hypnotist: 冴渡 夭 (Saewatari Yo, the share-house owner)
records.evidence: Official Lune Soft product page (18+ age gate; keywords 人妻, 催眠; 28 Feb 2020) and the 15 Nov 2019 announcement name newlywed wife Orina and fellow resident wife Sari, and describe the owner as a hypnosis researcher whose influence is presented as ordinary to the husband.
